packages.title: A stale share or dictation opens with no day, not a past one
brief: UX-1654 (S2), regression R1A-1 from P192 (UX-1623, D3 of 2026-10-20), found by review A in round 1 (`.claude/ux-review/runs/2026-10-19-app/verify-b6-r1-A.md`). What P192 did, and keep it: a free account's share now goes from `showCaptureSheet`'s typed-words branch (`App/lib/screens/voice_task_screen.dart:111-114`) to `openTaskForm(..., readsDates: typed.source == 'shared', heardAt: typed.capturedAt.toLocal())`, and `NewTaskScreen._start` (`App/lib/screens/edit_task_screen.dart:116-164`) reads the words with `QuickScheduleParser.parse(arguments.words, arguments.heardAt ?? now, day: later, keepAmbiguousHour: true)`. Review A verified UX-1623 as fixed. What's wrong: the day read counts from `heardAt`, the time of the share, and is never compared with today. A share «Llamar a Marta mañana» left in Sin guardar on Monday 19 (`App/lib/screens/captures_screen.dart:92`; for example, the app was killed with the form open) and resumed on Thursday 22 opens the form on Tuesday 20, a day already gone, and one Back (D12) saves it there without the person choosing it. Before P192 it opened with no day. Evidence: verified in code; the behaviour is inferred, not yet covered by a test or render. Rare, but the cost is a task the person may never find.

Fix, in `_NewTaskScreenState._start` only (`edit_task_screen.dart`, the `found` local built by the `QuickScheduleParser.parse` call, around :125-133): after parsing, if `found` has a date (`found.date != null`) and `Task.day(found.date!)` is before `today` (the `today` already computed from `calendarClockProvider` at the top of `_start`), treat it as if nothing was read: set `found` to null. A read deadline is handled the same way (`found.isDeadline`; its date is the deadline's). Everything below then falls back to what it did before P192: the title and notes come from `arguments.words` as written (`leadingTitle(arguments.words, ...)`), `dueDate` is `later` (the D9 day passed in, when it's after today, or null), `hasTime` false, no deadline. This is the form's existing rule for a passed-in day, `// Today, or a day gone by, adds nothing.` (:120-121); add one comment line beside the new check saying a day read from the words that has already gone by adds nothing either. Check the day only: a read day of today stays, even when its hour has passed (that's not this finding).

Because the check sits in `_start`, it also covers dictated words carried into the form with `readsDates` (D2; `_fillByHand`, `voice_task_screen.dart:1818-1858`, which passes `heardAt: session.capturedAt.toLocal()`) when such a dictation is resumed days later. That is intended and consistent; don't add a separate path for it.

No new copy, no ARB change, no new setting. Don't touch: `voice_task_screen.dart` (the `readsDates`/`heardAt` arguments stay as P192 left them), `App/lib/widgets/task_form_entry.dart`, `QuickScheduleParser`, the `later` rule for a passed-in day, the Pro path (a share opens the typing sheet), or source 'typed' (stays as written). Don't change the existing UX-1623 tests in `App/test/capture_free_dictations_test.dart` (group at :2892); add the new cases to that group, reusing its `share(...)` helper with `sharedAt:` and `_FreeApp.open(..., clock: ...)`. If the helper can't pass a capture's `day`, extend it with an optional `day` argument rather than writing a second helper.

Tests: the whole suite must keep passing, in particular the UX-1623 group (including 'captured Monday at 23:50 and opened Tuesday at 00:10 lands on Tuesday 20', where the read day equals today and must stay) and UX-918's shared half (:2831). If `App/test/capture_landing_test.dart` UX-1628 ('resuming 31 minutes later') fails near midnight, check whether it also fails without your change and say so in your notes rather than editing it (it reads `DateTime.now()`).
acceptance: Widget test, free account, Spanish, 1× text, the app's clock Thursday 22 October 2026 10:00: a capture with source 'shared', text «Llamar a Marta mañana», captured Monday 19 October 10:00 (local, Europe/Madrid), opened through `showCaptureSheet(captureId: ...)` as from Sin guardar: the form opens titled «Llamar a Marta mañana», and none of `new-task-today`, `new-task-tomorrow`, `new-task-pick-day` is selected; no chip shows Tuesday 20.
Same setup: Back saves the task with no due date and no deadline (it lands in Sin fecha), not on Tuesday 20.
Same setup, but the capture carries the day Friday 23 October (the D9 day, `typed.day`): the form opens on Friday 23, titled «Llamar a Marta mañana» as written.
Widget test, clock Thursday 22 October 10:00: a share «Llamar a Marta el viernes» captured Monday 19 October 10:00 still opens on Friday 23, titled «Llamar a Marta» (a read day still ahead is kept).
The existing UX-1623 tests pass unchanged, including the overnight one: captured Monday 19 at 23:50, opened Tuesday 20 at 00:10, «Llamar a Marta mañana» lands on Tuesday 20.

Code: in `_start`, a read result whose date (planned day or deadline) is before `today` by `calendarClockProvider` is discarded before the title and dates are built; nothing changes in `voice_task_screen.dart`, `task_form_entry.dart` or the ARB files.
deviceChecks: Emulator lane, free account: share «Llamar a Marta mañana» from another app, kill TaskFlow with the form open, move the emulator's date forward three days, resume it from Sin guardar: no day is selected and the title reads «Llamar a Marta mañana». Inferred from code until then.

packages.title: Cuenta: the name row ends in a chevron
brief: UX-1655 (S2), regression R1D-1 from P194 (UX-1515, D5 of 2026-10-20), found by review D in round 1 (`.claude/ux-review/runs/2026-10-19-app/verify-b6-r1-D.md`). What P194 did, and keep it: Cuenta has a row under the email, `ListTile(key: ValueKey('account-name'), leading: Icon(Icons.badge_outlined), ...)` (`App/lib/screens/account_screen.dart:199-212`), titled «Añadir tu nombre» with no subtitle, or «Nombre» with the name as its subtitle; its tap opens `editName(context)` (`App/lib/widgets/name_ask_sheet.dart:88-107`). Review D verified UX-1515 as fixed. What's wrong: the row has no trailing affordance, so «Nombre / María» looks exactly like the screen's read-only rows («Cuenta de Google vinculada», `account_screen.dart:215-219`, and the sync-status row «Guardado en tu cuenta») and reads as information, not as something to tap (render `settings/account.named.es.light.1x`; Norman 2013, signifiers; Nielsen, consistency). Settings' navigation rows all end in a chevron (`App/lib/screens/settings_screen.dart:105-137`), and so does the form's Recordatorio row.

Fix: add `trailing: const Icon(Icons.chevron_right_rounded),` to the `account-name` ListTile, exactly as the Settings rows have it (no colour or size override, since they have none). Nothing else changes: same title, subtitle, leading icon, key, `onTap` with its `busy` guard, and the 16 dp / 12 dp spacing around the row.

No new copy, no ARB change. Don't touch: the read-only rows (no chevrons there), the Google row or button, `name_ask_sheet.dart`, the heading with the name above the email (UX-1612), or any other screen. Re-render `settings/account.*` (`--plain-name "settings/account"`) so `App/build/ux/` holds current evidence.
Test: in the existing group 'UX-1515: the name row in Cuenta' in `App/test/name_ask_test.dart` (:755), add a check that the row's trailing is the chevron, in both states. Keep the suite passing.
acceptance: Widget test, Cuenta in Spanish at 1× text, account with no name: the `account-name` row reads «Añadir tu nombre» and its `trailing` is an `Icon` with `Icons.chevron_right_rounded`.
Same test with the name «María»: the row reads «Nombre» / «María» and also ends in `Icons.chevron_right_rounded`; tapping it still opens the sheet with key `name-ask-sheet`, filled with «María».
Cuenta in Spanish: the «Cuenta de Google vinculada» and «Guardado en tu cuenta» rows still have no trailing icon.

Renders `settings/account.named.es.light.1x` and `settings/account.email.*`: the chevron shows at the right of the name row. At 2× text, «Añadir tu nombre» (ES) and «Afegeix el teu nom» (CA) stay whole with the chevron beside them, nothing clipped.
AUDIT `settings/account · named` and `· email` still list the name row as a button at least 48 dp tall; TalkBack still reads «Nombre María», button (the chevron adds nothing to the reading).
